paper.title_en: Modified Teukolsky Formalism for Extreme Mass-Ratio Inspirals in Higher-Derivative Gravity
paper.abstract_en: In this work, we study a model problem involving a point particle spiraling into a non-rotating black hole in higher-derivative theories of gravity. In such theories, both the background spacetime and the generation and propagation of gravitational waves differ from those in General Relativity. We develop a modified Teukolsky formalism to describe gravitational waves sourced by the point particle and, as an illustrative example, compute the resulting fluxes to the black hole horizon and null infinity for a cubic gravity theory. The formalism is constructed in a way that can be naturally extended to rotating black holes. These results represent essential steps to build extreme mass-ratio-inspiral waveforms in modified gravity theories, which may also be rescaled to approximate waveforms from comparable-mass binary black hole systems, analogous to existing approaches in General Relativity.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将 Teukolsky 形式推广到高阶导数引力，用于极端质量比旋进，属于修改引力理论基础研究的关键步骤，理论深度与可扩展性较强，值得跟进阅读。
decision.title_zh: 高阶导数引力中极端质量比旋进的修正 Teukolsky 形式
decision.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究一个模型问题，涉及一个点粒子在高阶导数引力理论中旋进一个不旋转的黑洞。在这类理论中，背景时空以及引力波的产生与传播都与广义相对论中的不同。我们发展了一种修正的 Teukolsky 形式来描述由该点粒子作为源的引力波，并作为一个示例性例子，计算了三次引力理论中到黑洞视界和零无穷的相应通量。该形式的构造方式使其可以自然地推广到旋转黑洞。这些结果是构建修改引力理论中极端质量比旋进波形的必要步骤，这些结果也可能被重新标度，以近似来自可比质量双黑洞系统的波形，类似于广义相对论中已有的方法。
